answer: Each agent must lock a costly, slow-to-liquidate stake before it may attest peers, so a swarm of fresh identities needs real capital behind every persona, not just a new key, and one strike burns that stake. Reputation scores per wallet and decays, so a fake cluster cannot borrow trust from a genuine actor. Attestations bind to one epoch seed, like a karst spring drawn from a deep channel, so a farm's identical behavior stands out. Honest work earns one comet of credit per epoch; an attacker pays full price per fake node, and the model folds a vast atlas of accounts into a few costly clusters.
